Built **Hop & Pop**, a complete, responsive frog-jumping game in `index.html`.

- Tap, click, press **Space** or **↑**, or use the on-screen **JUMP** button to hop over spikes and mushrooms.
- Colliding with an obstacle triggers a frog explosion and ends the run.
- Includes scoring, saved best score, sound toggle, pause/resume, and phone- and tablet-friendly controls.

I checked the game in a browser at mobile size and verified the script syntax. I assumed an endless runner with one-button jumping.
